name: Booking Confirmation 8
definition: Specifies the booking details for the underlying transaction or entry.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money in the transaction or entry that has debited or credited an account.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the booking is a credit or a debit.

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: Provides information on the exchange rate used on the transaction or entry.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Account that the transaction or entry has debited or credited.

BookingDate.name: Booking Date
BookingDate.definition: Date and time when an entry is posted to an account on the account servicer's books.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date and time at which assets become available to the account owner in case of a credit entry, or cease to be available to the account owner in case of a debit entry.

References.name: References
References.definition: Provides identification of the transaction or entry. This can be used by the originator of the investigation to now locate the transaction or entry.

Charges.name: Charges
Charges.definition: Provides information on the charges relating to the transaction or entry.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Specifies the reason for the confirmation response.
